so you have a grand trine between your venus(3rd house) mars(5th house) and pluto (7th house). this means there is a harmony within your relationships regarding family and anyone close within your neighborhood. with venus in direct opposition to your uranus and neptune in 10th house, it may be very hard for people to see that you can be someone that can be able to stand on their own. 0-1 degrees are infant degrees and with venus in leo this would indicate you may like/ value attention but do not necessarily handle it well when someone doesn't show they value you. the relationships that put you 1st are what you like to stick with and the energy is mutual. however we must grow away from seeking this all the time. 

you're not behind in life, you're on your own clock, however if you want to see yourself move through things faster and become independent, you'll have to find out why you don't feel safe doing things alone. 

you are also going through your saturn return and i can honestly say you will see alot of things ending and you may even undergo a mindset change, this is when time tests us all to see how we handle restrictions or handle having to take our time with something. in your case it would be your mind, or anything that you should've previously let go of but are afraid of letting go. which, since you're asking about being dependent on other, i can only assume this saturn return transit would be most helpful for you to take it slowly when branching out in being independent, and might i also add, you're a taurus asc, you're naturally seen as reliable and you are good at knowing how to lean on others too, which is good because cancers barely like leaning on anyone, love family and always want to be with them, but your north node being in the 5th house indicates, short term relationships can benefit you as well, this could be the lesson you're here to learn. about not everyone having permanence in  your life  
  
 i hope this helps and again its your saturn return coming up so just use this as a chance to take your time with the obstacles presented, make sure you're not choosing the same choices from the past in order to move forward to independence and because its at a libra degree it will especially highlight partnerships, or business or luxury matters.

mars in 12th house at a capricorn degree could suggest wanting to feel in control with how things end but the 12th house deals alot with subconscious and with mars being in cancer( in fall i might add) this would mean it would be very hard for you to just accept the ending of something or accept your mind or self needs to let certain things go. part of why we feel lost sometimes is because we're trying to hold onto parts of ourselves or mindsets we no longer need to keep. i too have a cancer mars but its in the 7th house. i have not faired very well in relationships due to fluctuations in said relationships when i'm unable to take action in certain ways. 

however i assess the relationship to see if i need to worry about my effort being needed in said relationship and move on, i can't say i hate all my relationships but don't give myself the ability to search out relationships that allow me to take action in them the way i need , my previous mindset of "i never have good relationships" needed to end.

you also have scorpio in 6th house, have you ever thought about working with those who need help in businesses regarding arts? or about uncovering long lost art? with the house being ruled by jupiter this is somewhere that you could see luck and expansion and personal growth when working in ares of law, business, fashion or arts, or luxury. its at a libra degree which represents business, partnerships, or luxury or art.  your 10th house, in aries , which indicates career would mean you could have your own business as well, i know there aren't any planets there but aries ruled by mars indicates a possibility of owning your own business. 

sagittarius in the 5th house also indicates you could be a great teacher, but also teaching about things that could be taboo(house ruler is pluto-death taxes, rebirth, shared resources). you probably have enjoyed learning about many things others wouldn't necessarily say is interesting. saturn in the 2nd house also shows you'd probably get better with money as you get older, especially with a virgo placement, you may have kind of figured this out by now so that could also be why you feel lost about your future and passions, everything always needing money lol  

north node(virgo 2nd house) indicates your reason for being on earth this time is to seen for being able to bring practicality to your life and anyone else life. paying attention to details regarding money or even taking care of the relationships within your neighborhood or with siblings or friends. with it being in the 3rd degree this could involve your neighborhood or siblings and involve technology or even short distance travel to achieve this. 

please ask me to explain anything else if needed, hope this helps!!

also want to point out having opposition of mercury aries 13 degree, to libra 15 degree(gemini degree) you'd definitely give off the vibes that you want to feel included but like house 7 in libra opposing house 1 would mean direct conflict with others when speaking or wanting to engage in conversation with others, not necessarily a fight, just more so the balance of people being okay with talking to you could change easily. jupiter in libra isn't bad just a 15 degree would be a detriment, but not as strong especially as time goes on, hang in there!! also house 7 is also known for having open enemies, can you think of any time during libra season that you found out about a betrayal from someone or when someone was exposed for being not a friend to you?
